frame_convention.camera_optical_axes: +x image right, +y image down, +z optical forward
frame_convention.imu_axes: aligned with body in this simulation assumption

source_image_observations.layout: front trio and left/right upper/lower surround cameras, two controllers and SYNC

nominal_acquisition.synchronization_model: ideal nominal simultaneous capture; does not validate customer hardware synchronization

front_main.provenance: HFOV/resolution inherited from PDF-based baseline; explicit VFOV=130 from current user; independent fx/fy and centered principal point are simulation assumptions, not confirmed physical lens

front_stereo.provenance: resolution chosen at PDF minimum for both cameras; HFOV from PDF; equidistant model and circular cut-off are assumptions, not lens calibration

surround.provenance: resolution chosen at PDF minimum; 220 comes only from composition image; interpretation as full circular angle with 960 px diameter is an assumption

assumptions: All layout values other than the front 63 mm spacing and midpoint relation are proposed simulation values.
PDF center spacing is interpreted as nominal optical projection-center spacing for this simulation; real mechanical/optical offset requires supplier data.
Left and right refer to the wearer; this orientation convention is newly defined for unambiguous simulation.
Upper cameras look +Z and lower cameras look -Z; image roll is defined by explicit up vectors, not recovered from the picture.
All sensors are on one rigid assembly; no flex, thermal drift or structural dynamics are simulated.
Housing, lens barrels, heatsink, straps, cable and head are unmeasured occlusion proxies, not actual part geometry.
No opaque lens cap or decorative glass is placed in front of the virtual camera origin; lens refraction, entrance-pupil shift and internal vignetting are not simulated.
No machining holes, tolerances, material, mass, center of mass or PCB design are frozen by this model.
The 220 degree and 1000 IMU image labels do not replace the PDF technical requirements.
Results apply only to this configuration and its declared optical/geometry assumptions.

change_provenance.user_confirmation: C0/C1/C2 VFOV=130 degrees; this is not a PDF original requirement
change_provenance.composition_image: 220-degree circular interpretation retained; IMUx1000 does not replace 200 Hz

simulation.pixel_convention: continuous image edges [0,W] x [0,H]; pixel centers (column+0.5,row+0.5); principal point (W/2,H/2)
